collectible:1.text: Spaceship Parts are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. There are 50 devices scattered around San Andreas, which are claimed to have been dropped by a spaceship after it crashed. Omega, a hippie from the Grand Senora Desert who claims to have been abducted by said spaceship in the day it crashed, can be encountered in Grand Senora Desert by Franklin Clinton after the mission Fame or Shame.

collectible:2.text: Letter Scraps are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. In 1975, famous Vinewood starlet Leonora Johnson was brutally murdered, and her dismembered body was found at the Land Act Dam. Shortly after, Leonora's killer, sent a letter to Richards Majestic Productions founder David Richards, confessing his crime. The letter remained a secret until 2013.

collectible:3.text: The Epsilon Tract is a collection challenge that becomes available after completing the eighth and final Epsilon mission: Unknowing the Truth, regardless of the said mission's outcome. Michael will receive an e-mail, after completing the final Epsilon mission, from Marnie explaining that the tract collections are available, and clues to find them.

collectible:4.text: Nuclear Waste are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. According to an internet news article from Public Liberty Online after the mission Fame or Shame, the nuclear waste tanks were deposited into the ocean following a winter storm. The are a total of 30 Nuclear Waste barrels around San Andreas.

collectible:5.text: Submarine Pieces are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. There are 30 pieces of the submarine belonging to the late producer Frank Mathers, scattered around San Andreas, which the player must find and collect. These collectibles are tied to Abigail Mathers's Strangers and Freaks mission strand, unlocked after Blitz Play and the purchase of the Sonar Collections Dock in Paleto Cove.

collectible:6.text: A Peyote Plant is a collectible featured in the enhanced version of Grand Theft Auto V. It can be consumed by the player. Named after the real-life Peyote cactus which contains psychoactive properties, this plant seemingly has some sort of hallucinogenic effect on the protagonist's brain and body once taken.

collectible:7.text: Monkey Mosaics are exclusive collectibles in the enhanced version of Grand Theft Auto V. Players can access this content regardless of whether they are a returning player or not, although limited for non-returning players. After completing the mission Repossession, Franklin will receive a text message from Lamar saying that a street artist has been painting monkey mosaics in walls across Los Santos.

collectible:8.page: Unique Stunt Jumps in GTA Vice City
collectible:8.text: Stunt Jumps are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. There are 36 jumps located around Vice City. Each completed stunt jump earns the player a reward of $100 multiplied by the number of jumps completed (for the n-th jump, $100*n). The 36th jump earns the player $10,000. Additional Insane Stunt Bonus payments can also be earned as the player completes each unique jump.

collectible:9.text: Under the Bridge is a miscellaneous challenge in Grand Theft Auto V. It requires the player to fly an aircraft or helicopter under 50 bridges around the game world to complete part of the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy. The player will also need to complete all 15 Knife Flight challenges in order to fully complete the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy.

collectible:10.text: Knife Flights are a miscellaneous challenge in Grand Theft Auto V. It requires the player to use a fixed-wing aircraft (helicopters can not perform a knife) and fly with the wings aligned vertically (a.k.a. knife) in between 15 sets of buildings around the game world to complete part the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy.

easter-egg:1.text: Mount Chiliad is one of three named mountains in Blaine County, San Andreas in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online, the others being Mount Josiah and Mount Gordo. Mount Chiliad is the tallest peak in the state. Located far to the north, in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness, it serves as the tallest mountain in the game at 2774m  above sea level. Two small towns sit at its base.

easter-egg:3.text: The Fort Zancudo stealth aircraft is an unnamed, uncontrollable stealth aircraft appearing in Grand Theft Auto V and introduced in Grand Theft Auto Online as part of the Los Santos Summer Special update. The stealth aircraft appears to be influenced by the Northrop B-2 Spirit, but with many flat panels extending out in all directions and forming a rough circular shape.

easter-egg:5.text: The State of North Yankton is a state that appears in Grand Theft Auto V, being featured in the missions Prologue and Bury the Hatchet, and appears as a seasonal Survival mode setting in Grand Theft Auto Online as part of the continuation of the Bottom Dollar Bounties update.

easter-egg:6.text: Mount Gordo is one of three named mountain peaks in San Andreas in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online, the others being Mount Chiliad and Mount Josiah. Mount Gordo is the smallest of the three. It is located in the northeast of Blaine County. A small lake can be found here, as well as a small pond. The mountain is the site of the Jolene Cranley-Evans ghost easter egg.

easter-egg:8.text: Leonora Johnson is a character mentioned in Grand Theft Auto V. Leonora Johnson was born on August 29th, 1952 in the Midwest. Her father, Harold, was a chicken farmer and her mother, Ellen, was a slopper at a dairy farm. She suffered lung problems due to heavy smoking during childhood.

easter-egg:9.page: Libertytreeonline.com/Serial Killer Leaves Note But No Clues
easter-egg:9.text: Serial Killer Leaves Note But No Clues is a newspaper article on the Liberty Tree in-game website of Grand Theft Auto IV. The article was written by Tony J. Smith and published in 2008. It is available to read via internet after the completion of the mission Harboring a Grudge.
